title: Cannoli v1.0.5 — Results publishing & spoiler tags
body:
- Admins publish each league's results — standings, stats, and player/Pokemon records stay frozen until you publish that week, and each league publishes separately (feature)
- Schedule and replays now use per-match spoiler tags — reveal just the battles you want to know about, and they stay revealed (feature)
- Matchup Center type chart adds a team summary row showing which types you best resist and are most weak to (feature)

title: Cannoli v1.0.4 — Animated replay sprites
body: - Replays now play with animated Pokemon sprites instead of static ones (fix)

title: Cannoli v1.0.3 — Spoiler-free mode
body:
- Spoiler-free mode — hide match results (scores, winners, MVP/sweep/tera badges) on the standings and replays pages behind a click-to-reveal blur. Team names stay visible so you can still browse. Toggle it from the page header or Settings → Preferences (feature)
- Arena matches no longer disappear after an admin sets a league's week dates — a week's matches are now due at the end of that week (when the next week starts), instead of being treated as overdue on the week's start date (fix)

title: Cannoli v1.0.2 — Launch-week fixes
body:
- Theory-craft with taken Pokemon to preview future trades (feature)
- Uneven trades — swap any number of Pokemon per side (feature)
- Free agents: pick up and drop multiple Pokemon at once (feature)
- Admins can set week dates on an active league (feature)
- Admins can attach a battle played outside the Arena to a scheduled match — records the result, stats, and replay (feature)
- Profile pictures display everywhere, with a reset-to-default button (fix)
- Future weeks no longer show Week 1's dates (fix)
- Colorblind mode now covers the team page's defensive types (fix)
- Team nicknames no longer hidden behind the cost badge (fix)
- Readable Matchup Center team dropdown (fix)
- No more blank line in replay Tera Captains (fix)
- Animated sprites in replays (improvement)

title: Cannoli v1.0.1 — Market hub, notifications & announcements
body:
- Trade Block and Free Agents are now one Market hub — shared budget/deadline header, list or unlist mons on the block, and a single trade composer with a live legality meter (feature)
- New notifications bell collecting announcements, What's New, and updates on feedback you reported (feature)
- Announcements can post as a site-wide banner, in the notifications bell, or both — targetable by league or role, editable, with a full history of everything sent (feature)
- Send categorized feedback with screenshots, and get notified when it's resolved (feature)
- Collapsible sidebar — icon rail with league flyouts on desktop, slide-in drawer on mobile (feature)
- The sim client now shows the live site announcement in its news pane (feature)
- Sim battle rooms for every league self-heal and stay available after reseeds or restarts (fix)
- Trade pickers show team names instead of internal ids (fix)
- The What's New bell clears reliably, even for entries dated slightly ahead (fix)
- Replay viewer scales the battle stage to fill the embed (improvement)

title: Cannoli 1.0 — Day 1 patch
body:
- Season 11 is live on the new National Dex+ scaling, rules synced (feature)
- Pick which week a battle counts for — play ahead or make up matches (feature)
- Nickname your Pokemon from the new Manage Roster panel (feature)
- Unified draft-pool search by name, type, move, ability or cost (feature)
- Watch every Season 9–11 replay in-app (feature)
- Upload a custom team logo (feature)
- Complete National Dex+ types and learnsets — tier list and coverage fixed (fix)
- Edit tera captains and tera types any time during the season (fix)
- Matchup Center is public — scout without signing in (improvement)
- Animated login and replay backgrounds, 3D sidebar gems (improvement)
- Smoother recovery after updates, with new error tracking (improvement)
